-- Read/reexport the reproduced complete master; no source or drawing edits.
local source=assert(app.params.source)
local output=assert(app.params.output)
assert(not app.fs.isDirectory(output), "use a fresh verification output")
app.fs.makeAllDirectories(output)
local s=assert(app.open(source))
local durations={}
for i,frame in ipairs(s.frames) do
  local image=Image(s.width,s.height,ColorMode.RGB)
  image:drawSprite(s,frame.frameNumber)
  image:saveAs(app.fs.joinPath(output,string.format("%04d.png",i-1)))
  durations[i]=math.floor(frame.duration*1000+.5)
end
local proof=assert(io.open(app.fs.joinPath(output,"master_proof.json"),"wb"))
proof:write(json.encode{layers=#s.layers,count=#s.frames,cels=#s.cels,canvas={s.width,s.height},durations_ms=durations},"\n")
proof:close();s:close()
print("Reopened unchanged complete master and exported all cels for comparison")
